# `aitbc config get-secret`

Get a decoded secret value from the local secrets file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config get-secret [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--key` | text | — | yes | The Key. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config get-secret --key <key>
```
